decisions.why: all 15 captured items are named clinical and departmental software modules read from the company's own solutions post type on nexus-hdc.com (Vendor Neutral Archive, Orders and Results, Care Pathway and Nursing, Pre-assessment Patient Portal, Cloud Hosted Solus Endoscopy, PacePort, ImagePort, Integration and interfaces, Respiratory Physiology, Neurophysiology, Cardiology, Cystoscopy, Bronchoscopy, GI Endoscopy, Scheduling) — HD Clinical trades as Nexus HDC and its whole business is departmental clinical reporting and imaging software (the Solus endoscopy reporting suite, cardiology and physiology reporting, VNA/image management, order comms and scheduling), matching the digital:sw description 'clinical and departmental software systems (imaging, oncology, laboratory and asset-tracking)'. The clinical-area names in the list (Cardiology, Neurophysiology, Cystoscopy, Bronchoscopy, GI Endoscopy, Respiratory Physiology) are that company's software modules FOR those departments, not devices sold into them — each page sits under the same solutions post type as PacePort and ImagePort and describes a reporting/management system, so none is filed against its clinical speciality. The site carries no division segment of its own, so the crawl read one bucket from the pages' own breadcrumb trail; this is the same single-bucket shape already accepted for Sectra Limited, and for the same reason: it is the company's entire range, not a slice of it. HD Clinical Ltd is a named supplier on this framework's own awarded-supplier list (NHS Supply Chain, Digital Diagnostic Solutions, 54 suppliers).
